paragraphs.text: This was either the beginning of a certain song, or the words which David uttered when he stayed his affection.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He compares the afflictions which God lays on his children, to a storm that comes and goes.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Who does not leave his works begun imperfectly.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: He would rather deliver me by a miracle, than that I should be overcome.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He means their slanderous and false reports.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Do not permit me to be destroyed to the contempt of your Name.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: For fear, seeing the great dangers on all sides.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, wholly bent to give you praise for my deliverance.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: He shows that both his heart will praise God, and his tongue will confess him, and also he will use other means to provoke himself forward to the same.
paragraphs.label: i
paragraphs.anchor: I will sing and give praise

paragraphs.text: Your mercies not only belong to the Jews, but also to the Gentiles.
paragraphs.label: k
